testsuite.name: com.digitalpapyrus.authenticator.SmsReceiverTest

testcase.name: normalizeToE164 returns as-is for unrecognizable format
normalizeToE164 returns unchanged for E164 format with plus
normalizeToE164 uses custom country code when provided
normalizeToE164 adds plus to country code format
normalizeToE164 adds country code to local format
normalizeToE164 preserves original for malformed numbers
normalizeToE164 returns as-is for international format without plus
normalizeToE164 is case-sensitive for country code
